jobs.title: Event Security Officer
jobs.description:
Attention: Candidates must currently hold a position as a Police Officer, Corrections Officer, or be a Retired Police Officer with arrest powers in the state of Illinois to be eligible for this role!

Are you passionate about live music, sports, and exciting events? Join Andy Frain Services as we hire Event Security Officers for the thrilling 2026 Summer/Fall Entertainment Season. We have available roles at music festivals, sporting events this summer, and various concerts and conventions throughout the year at venues in the City of Chicago!

This is a fantastic opportunity for part-time or secondary work, allowing you to set your own schedule based on availability!

JOB SUMMARY:

As an Event Security Officer, you will play a crucial role in supporting our clients in stadiums, arenas, convention centers, music festivals, and theaters. Your primary responsibilities include observing and reporting activities, ensuring safety and security for the venue’s property and personnel, and maintaining a professional image that contributes to making each venue a safe and memorable experience for guests.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Your duties may vary by event, audience size, and location. Reasonable accommodations will be considered for ADA compliance. Other tasks may also be assigned as needed.

  • Arrive on time and report to your designated post in complete uniform.
  • Deliver exceptional service and engage positively with customers, ensuring a professional demeanor at all times. Every employee is responsible for outstanding customer service!
  • Maintain familiarity with all emergency policies, procedures, and regulations. Respond promptly to emergency alarms or calls for assistance, determine appropriate actions, notify relevant authorities, and provide assistance as necessary.
  • Follow specific post orders which may involve wanding, operating metal detectors, conducting bag searches, pat downs, or other tasks as required.
  • Stay vigilant and aware of safety protocols.
  • Understand post orders, stay updated on any revisions and daily event needs, and know your chain of command.
  • Be prepared to expand your responsibilities as per client requests.

This job description outlines the general responsibilities associated with the position but is not exhaustive. Andy Frain Services reserves the right to modify, supplement, or change the duties and responsibilities in its sole discretion. Additional duties may be assigned as necessary.

jobs.title: Event Safety & Guest Experience Officer
jobs.description:
Location: Chicago & Surrounding Suburbs | Employment Type: Seasonal, May-August | Compensation: $25.00 an hour

About Inner Valor

At Inner Valor, we deliver hospitality-driven security for large-scale festivals and high-profile events. Our officers are not simply present—they are engaged, observant, and proactive, creating a safe environment while enhancing the guest experience.

Position Summary

We are seeking high-performing Event Security Officers who demonstrate strong judgment, professional presence, and the ability to operate effectively in fast-paced, high-attendance environments.

This role is best suited for individuals who take pride in their work, communicate confidently, and can anticipate and address issues before they escalate.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Execute access control operations, including ID verification and credential enforcement, with consistency and professionalism
  • Conduct security screenings, including bag checks and handheld or walk through metal detector procedures, in accordance with site protocols
  • Maintain situational awareness across large crowds, identifying risks early
  • Support safe and efficient guest flow, including entry, exit, and restricted areas
  • Apply clear communication and de-escalation techniques when addressing issues
  • Respond decisively to incidents, disturbances, and emergency situations
  • Represent Inner Valor with a polished, customer-focused presence at all times

What Sets You Apart

We are looking for individuals who demonstrate:

  • Strong awareness, attention to detail, and decision-making ability
  • The ability to remain calm, composed, and professional under pressure
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • A team-first mindset with a high level of accountability
  • Reliability—you show up early, prepared, and ready to perform

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 18+ years old with a high school diploma or GED
  • Ability to work long shifts (8-12+ hour shifts) in dynamic environments
  • Reliable transportation to various event locations across Chicago and the suburbs
  • Exceptional customer service and communication skills
  • Comfortable working in outdoor event environments
  • Must pass background check and drug test

Preferred Qualifications:

  • PERC card & 20-hour Basic Security Training certification
  • Experience in event security, hospitality, military, or law enforcement
  • CPR/First Aid certification
  • Prior experience working large-scale events or high-attendance venues

Physical & Mental Requirement:

This role requires sustained physical presence, environmental adaptability, and continuous alertness in dynamic event settings. Responsibilities include:

  • Remaining on your feet for extended periods (8–12+ hours), including standing, walking, and active monitoring
  • Working outdoors for prolonged durations in varying weather conditions (heat, sun, wind, rain, and other environmental factors)
  • Operating effectively in crowded, high-noise environments, including entry points and screening areas
  • Maintaining constant situational awareness, attention to detail, and focus throughout the duration of the shift
  • Communicating clearly and effectively with guests and team members in fast-paced and sometimes stressful conditions
  • Navigating dense crowds, restricted areas, stairs, and uneven terrain as required by the event site
  • Responding quickly to incidents, including rapid movement over short distances when necessary
  • Occasionally lifting, carrying, pushing, or pulling up to 25 pounds

jobs.title: Event Security - Conventions
jobs.description:
Welcome to Allied Universal, where we prioritize safety and security above all else. We are currently seeking dedicated individuals to join our team as Event Security for conventions. In this role, you will have the opportunity to be a crucial part of ensuring the well-being of both attendees and participants at various conventions. We are looking for candidates who possess strong communication skills, a keen eye for detail, and the ability to handle high-pressure situations with professionalism. If you are passionate about security and making a positive impact, then this is the perfect opportunity for you. Join us and be part of our mission to provide top-notch event security services.\n\nGreet and welcome attendees and participants at various conventions with a friendly and professional demeanor. Ensure the safety and security of all individuals at the event by monitoring and patrolling the premises. Identify and address any potential security threats or concerns in a timely and efficient manner. Communicate effectively with team members, event staff, and law enforcement to coordinate security efforts. Maintain accurate logs and reports of any incidents or activities during the event. Enforce event rules and regulations to ensure a safe and organized environment. Monitor and control access points to the event, ensuring only authorized individuals are allowed entry. Respond promptly and appropriately to any emergency situations that may arise. Conduct bag checks and security screenings as necessary. Remain vigilant and alert at all times to identify and prevent any potential security breaches. Provide excellent customer service to attendees and participants, addressing any inquiries or concerns with professionalism. Adhere to company policies and procedures, as well as local and federal laws, at all times. Attend training sessions and meetings to stay updated on security protocols and procedures. Represent Allied Universal and the event in a positive manner at all times. Collaborate with team members to ensure a smooth and efficient operation.

Allied Universal is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

jobs.title: Executive Protection and Event Security Manager
jobs.description:
Welcome to TransUnion, a global leader in information and risk management. We are currently seeking a highly skilled and experienced Executive Protection and Event Security Manager to join our team. As the Executive Protection and Event Security Manager, you will play a critical role in ensuring the safety and security of our executives and events. This is a dynamic and challenging position that requires a combination of strategic thinking, strong leadership abilities, and hands-on security experience. If you are passionate about protecting people and assets, and have the necessary qualifications and experience, we would love to hear from you. Develop and implement security protocols and procedures to ensure the safety and security of TransUnion executives and events. Conduct thorough risk assessments and provide recommendations for mitigating potential security threats. Manage and oversee the day-to-day operations of the executive protection and event security team. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify security needs and develop strategies to address them. Provide leadership and direction to security personnel, ensuring they are properly trained and equipped to handle any potential security situations. Monitor and assess security-related incidents and make necessary adjustments to protocols as needed. Stay up-to-date on industry best practices and trends in executive protection and event security to continuously improve and enhance security measures. Manage and maintain relationships with external security vendors and contractors. Prepare and manage budgets for security operations and ensure resources are allocated effectively. Oversee the planning and execution of security operations for high-profile events, including coordinating with local law enforcement and other agencies. Conduct investigations into security incidents and provide detailed reports and recommendations. Ensure compliance with all relevant laws, regulations, and company policies related to security and risk management. Serve as the primary point of contact for all security-related matters and communicate effectively with all levels of the organization. Maintain confidentiality and discretion when handling sensitive information related to executive protection and event security. Act as a liaison between TransUnion executives, event organizers, and security personnel to ensure a smooth and secure experience.

TransUnion is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Our focus is our clients, customers, fans, participants, and employees. Professionalism, courtesy, focus, communication, and appearance are cornerstones of our company.

The ideal candidate for this position is dependable, excellent in customer service, and has an impressive ability to communicate verbally. Come be a part of the action! Be part of a team that has pride in its outstanding staff. This job is based on a part-time/full-time event-based schedule - work when you are able! We offer bi-weekly pay, opportunity for advancement, and a job you can enjoy! Apply today!

JOB SUMMARY:

Provide event security detail with a customer service style. Employees will always perform job duties with a constant awareness of surroundings, making note of all activity that takes place in the assigned area. Employees must maintain a professional image and always demonstrate excellent customer service.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Maintain professional image that includes greeting customers, visitors and employees in a polite and friendly manner.

Company Overview


Join P4 Companies — including P4 Security Solutions and P4 Protective Services — leaders in professional security services. We offer flexible opportunities for both security professionals and law enforcement officers across multiple industries. We are looking for individuals who bring vigilance, integrity, and professionalism, and who take pride in being a visible, reassuring presence. If you value teamwork and want a career with growth potential in the security field, P4 Companies may be the right fit for you.

Opportunities for Security Officers
Provide security at commercial buildings, residential communities, manufacturing sites, retail, campuses, cannabis facilities, and events. Key duties include:

  • Customer service and access control

  • Patrols and incident response

  • Site monitoring and safety enforcement

  • Ideal for individuals seeking stability, teamwork, and career growth in security.

Opportunities for Active or Retired Law Enforcement
Specialized assignments throughout Illinois, including executive protection, patrol programs, healthcare, campuses, private venues, and retail.

  • Flexible scheduling

  • Competitive rates statewide

  • Perfect for officers seeking supplemental income or flexible off-duty work.

Officers bring their advanced training, professionalism, and command presence to ensure safety in high-trust environments. Your experience makes a difference, and Security Solutions values your service and leadership. Whether you are beginning your security career or leveraging decades of law enforcement experience, The Companies provide a path for meaningful and rewarding work. Join us in making safety and service a priority.

jobs.description:
Madison Square Garden Entertainment Corp. (MSG Entertainment) is a leader in live entertainment, delivering unforgettable experiences while forging deep connections with diverse and passionate audiences. The Company's portfolio includes a collection of world-renowned venues - New York's Madison Square Garden, Infosys Theater at Madison Square Garden, Radio City Music Hall, and Beacon Theatre; and The Chicago Theatre - that showcase a broad array of sporting events, concerts, family shows, and special events for millions of guests annually. In addition, the Company features the original production, the Christmas Spectacular Starring the Radio City Rockettes, which has been a holiday tradition for more than 90 years. More information is available at www.msgentertainment.com.

Who are we hiring?

As an Event Security Officer at the Chicago Theatre you will promote positive guest/client experiences during the beginning (ingress), middle of event and show departure (egress). Event Security Officers are responsible for greeting guests, searching bags and wanding guests if they alarm on the magnetometers. This role will also ensure the safety of guests, assist with emergency or medical situations, and answer general questions regarding the event or the Chicago Theatre. As a crucial member of our team, Chicago Event Security Officers may be requested to work a flexible schedule inclusive of early mornings, day & evening shifts (late evenings may be required), weekends, holidays and back to back events. Additionally, Event Security Officers may be assigned to an area with adverse temperature/weather conditions such as observing the surroundings for any threats or directing guests in/out of the theater while being positioned outside of the building. Event Security Officers will be required to stand and move freely throughout the property during their shift.

What will you do?

  • Ensure protection of facilities, properties, employees and guests of The Chicago Theatre.
  • Promote positive guest/client experience. Uphold commitment of MSG "Circle of Service" standards and MSG's Mission and Values.
  • Maintain professional manner, presence, and appearance at all times while on premises
  • Arrive for scheduled shift on time and in proper MSG approved uniform.
  • Prevent access to any areas of the facility by any unauthorized individuals.
  • Conduct building tours, monitor CCTV and alarm systems and control building access.
  • Responsible for checking bags and screening guests/employees to ensure overall safety.
  • Serve as a security escort and respond to security assistance calls during performances and operating hours.
  • Be prepared to take an active role in Emergency Operations procedures (evacuation plan) through on-going training and drills.
  • Lock/unlock facility doors according to scheduled requirements.
  • Prevent sales of all unauthorized merchandise and tickets in and around venue
  • Provide exceptional experiences for our guests, partners, and team members, including by adhering to our appearance and presentation guidelines while on-site.

What do you need to succeed?

  • Strong verbal communication skills and demonstrated ability to work well under pressure.
  • Will have the ability to enforce departmental policies and procedures with fairness and consistency.
  • Will utilize a bullhorn and radio to direct guests.
  • Previous security experience required.
  • Must be able to obtain PERC Card upon request.
  • Obtain Fire Guard certificate upon request.

Special Requirements

  • Must be receptive to working outside in inclement weather and extreme temperatures.
  • Able to walk and stand during the entire shift.
  • Lifting, pushing, pulling up to 25 lbs.
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule including nights, have split days off, work weekends and holidays in a 24 X 7 environment.
  • Responsibilities must be done onsite

#LI-Onsite

Hourly Pay Range

$19.30-$19.30 USD

We are proud to offer a robust set of tools and resources to help employees understand their interests and purpose, harness their talents and obtain the skills they need to reach the next step in their careers. Growth and longevity for our employees are top priorities here.
